## Context / Problem

## Approach
Condense only anchored comments and true leading docstrings in Scope. Preserve every non-docstring runtime string, constant, regex, fixture value, subprocess argument, decorator, assertion, and executable statement.

Parse immutable before/final blobs with `type_comments=True`; remove only allowlisted leading docstrings from modules, classes, functions, and async functions; normalize only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`; and require the remaining ASTs to match. Restrict comment edits to anchored blocks and adjacent blank lines. Compare directives, inline comments, and shebangs byte-for-byte.

## Scope
- `sync_contention_harness.py` module docstring — retain the shared harness, `_clear_sync_throttle`, and bare-import fixture topology.
- `test_atomic_ticket_dir_create_021d.py` module docstring — retain atomic publication, no-debris behavior, and interruption at the write-lock boundary.
- `test_event_append_transient_retry.py` module; three stderr-constant blocks; and retry/healing docstrings — retain classifier signatures and pre/post-ref retry boundaries.
